categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Utils/log/libs' label and modifies shared utility wrapper `src/util/fs.cpp`.
categories.rationale: Prevents file descriptor and handle leaks to child processes by ensuring files opened via `fsbridge::fopen` are non-inheritable. While preventing unintended descriptor leakage to spawned processes (like alert scripts or external signers) is solid hygiene, it addresses a minor vulnerability without active operational fallout.
